projection.name: weaviate
projection.title: Weaviate
projection.description: Weaviate cockpit: collection schema, object CRUD, GraphQL and vector/hybrid search, cross-reference graphs, embedding projection, shards, tenants, and backups.

fields.label: Endpoint
fields.help: REST and GraphQL base URL. The gateway owns egress; the plugin never dials directly.

fields.label: API key
fields.help: Sent as an Authorization bearer token.

fields.label: Inference API header
fields.help: Header a vectorizer or reranker module needs for nearText and generative queries.

fields.label: Read-only mode
fields.help: Blocks schema, object, tenant, alias, shard, and backup mutations.

fields.label: Embedding sample size
fields.help: Objects fetched for the 2D embedding projection.

config.emptyText: No collections yet. Create one to define a schema and start importing objects.

config.label: GraphQL
config.emptyText: Run a Weaviate GraphQL query to see results. Get, Aggregate, Explore, and schema introspection are supported.
This server runs without optional modules.
Schema changes, writes, and queries you run from this connection appear here.
This collection has no properties. Add one to make objects searchable.
No objects yet. Insert one or import a batch to populate this collection.

config.label: Vector search
config.emptyText: Describe a search: mode is fetch, nearVector, bm25, nearText, or hybrid. fetch, nearVector, and bm25 need no vectorizer; nearText and hybrid embed the query text and need one. Add where, sort, properties, limit, and target_vector as needed.

config.ariaLabel: Two-dimensional PCA projection of this collection's vectors
config.instructions: Hover or click a point to inspect an object. Arrow keys move the selection, R reloads the sample, plus and minus zoom, 0 resets.

config.emptyText: No shards reported for this collection.
No tenants yet. Create one to isolate this collection's data.
No aliases point at this collection.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: CamelCase, starting with an uppercase letter.

validators.message: start with an uppercase letter; letters, digits, and underscores only

fields.label: Vectorizer module
fields.help: Use none to supply vectors yourself.

actions.label: Delete collection
actions.confirmText: Delete this collection with every object, vector, and shard it holds? This cannot be undone.

fields.label: Data type
fields.help: Use a collection name to create a cross-reference.

actions.label: Delete object
actions.confirmText: Delete this object and its vectors? This cannot be undone.

actions.label: Delete by filter
actions.confirmText: Delete every object matching this filter, with its vectors? Run it as a dry run first to see how many match.

fields.label: Where filter
fields.help: Weaviate where-filter JSON. Every matching object and its vectors are deleted.

fields.label: Dry run
fields.help: Count the matches without deleting anything.

fields.label: Target collection
fields.help: Defaults to the property's declared target.

actions.label: Remove reference
actions.confirmText: Remove this cross-reference? The target object is kept.

fields.label: Target collection
fields.help: Defaults to the property's declared target.

actions.label: Set shard status
actions.confirmText: Change this shard's status? READONLY stops accepting writes on this shard.

actions.label: Set tenant status
actions.confirmText: Change this tenant's activity status? INACTIVE and OFFLOADED take its objects out of service.

actions.label: Delete tenant
actions.confirmText: Delete the selected tenant(s) and every object stored under them?

fields.label: Alias
fields.help: Aliases stand in for collection names, so they follow the same CamelCase rule.

validators.message: start with an uppercase letter; letters, digits, and underscores only

actions.label: Delete alias
actions.confirmText: Delete the selected alias(es)? The target collection is kept.

validators.message: letters, digits, dots, dashes, and underscores only

fields.label: Collections
fields.help: Leave empty to back up every collection.

actions.label: Restore backup
actions.confirmText: Restore this backup? Collections in the backup must not already exist on this cluster.

actions.label: Cancel backup
actions.confirmText: Cancel the selected backup(s)? Partially written data is discarded.
